quotes.text: By this point, he had spent several years searching the rural South for both white and black musicians who exhibited raw talent. He was looking for music that would make a deep connection with the real lived experiences of people regardless of race. And he knew that getting a recording of such raw humanity, regardless of the musician's professional experience in a studio, took time and experimentation.
